Wonder Box Lab

Privacy policy

A short policy for a small website. This page covers the Wonder Box Lab website only.

Effective November 2026

Scope

This policy explains how Wonder Box Lab handles information on this website. It does not replace the privacy policy for any product. Tap Defense has a separately published policy, and a RushTrail Runaway policy will be published before that product's release.

Information you give us

This site does not ask you to create an account or submit a form. If you email us, we receive your email address and whatever you choose to include in the message. We use that information to reply and to handle the request. We do not sell it.

Information collected automatically

This is a static website. We do not use analytics, advertising cookies, tracking pixels, or third-party embeds. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, which processes technical information such as IP addresses and request logs to deliver and secure the site. That processing is governed by GitHub's privacy statement.

Cookies

This website does not set cookies. All fonts, images, and scripts are served from this site. Clicking a link to another website, such as Google Play or GitHub, takes you to a service with its own privacy practices.

How we use and keep information

Email correspondence is used to respond to your message, provide support, and meet legal obligations where applicable. We keep it only for as long as needed for those purposes, then delete or archive it as appropriate.

Your choices

You can ask us about the information you sent by email, request a correction, or ask us to delete it. We will consider requests consistent with applicable law. Email emrulkayes031@gmail.com with “Privacy request” in the subject.

Children

This website is a general-audience site about Wonder Box Lab and its products. It is not directed to children. Product-specific policies describe the audience and data practices for each product.

Changes to this policy

If this policy changes, the updated version will be posted here with a new effective date. Material changes will be reflected on this page.

Contact

Questions about this policy can be sent to emrulkayes031@gmail.com.
